newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's July consumer prices up 0.66 percent.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's July consumer prices up 0.66 percent.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index (CPI) rose by 0.66 percent month-on-month in July, compared with a fall of 0.17 percent in June, a government official said on Saturday.
The official told Reuters the CPI rose 0.66 percent in July. The figures will also be announced at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
He said food rose by 1.10 percent, housing rose 0.21 percent, textiles 0.19 percent and services by 0.70 percent.
Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent for the 1996 calendar year against 8.64 percent in 1995.
The government has forecast an inflation rate of six percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year starting on April 1.
